ridgecrest_schema.columns: YYYY MM dd hh mm ss.sss lat lon depth mag ID (whitespace-separated; '#' header lines)
ridgecrest_schema.time_convention: Header gives no time zone. The M7.1 event is at 2019-07-06 03:19:52.86; the widely published origin time is 03:19:53 UTC, so the times are treated as UTC (empirical check, not stated in the file).
ridgecrest_schema.depth: km, nominally referenced to the surface taken as 0.7 km above sea level (header)
ridgecrest_schema.mag: SCSN preferred magnitude for SCSN events; calibrated ML-like scaling for template-detected events (header)
ridgecrest_schema.ids: event_id values are not CISN IDs (header)
ridgecrest_schema.caveat: Events not individually checked; large errors may exist (header)
